audit.whatIsWrong: The page rates this 8.5/10 and calls it a hard matchup in report[14], while the diff enum says EVEN and Poppy wins 51.21% over 412 games. Three answers to one question.
audit.why: A 51% win rate does not support an 8.5/10 difficulty, and the chart giving Teemo five of seven stages compounds it.
audit.corrected: Chart brought to the packet's shape (see point 3). The diff/diffRating conflict is raised in questionsForUser rather than guessed at — I do not know which enum token the site uses between EVEN and the red-tone tier.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 4 gave Teemo the stage at 2/10 while their own whys say otherwise — whys[0] 'he can only poke a tank for chip', whys[1] 'neither of you kills', whys[2] 'your single best early window', whys[4] 'it keeps you safe'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Skill/Poppy/Skill/Skill/Skill/Teemo — a lane that is level with one Poppy window and a Teemo late game, which is what a 51.21% win rate looks like.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1 and 4 to Skill, row 2 to Poppy, both layers as one group, with the 2/10 ratings raised to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page states in four places that Blinding Dart 'cancels your Q autos and your AA' — i.e. that the blind shuts off Hammer Shock. A blind removes basic attacks only. Hammer Shock's zone and the Heroic Charge wall stun both land through it in full. Separately, 'W deletes his dash' has nothing to delete: Move Quick is a move-speed buff, not a dash.
audit.why: This is the decisive interaction of the matchup and the page had it backwards — a Poppy who believes her Q is blanked by the blind simply stops pressing her strongest button. The mirror audit teemo__poppy states the same fact from Teemo's side: the blind takes her auto damage, the abilities still land.
audit.corrected: Blind restated as autos-only with Q and E landing through it, on its flat 7s cooldown; W restated as the armour/MR steroid and move speed, since Teemo has no dash to stop.

audit.whatIsWrong: Blinding Dart was tracked with no number.
audit.why: It is a flat 7s at every rank — a short, countable window rather than something to fear indefinitely.
audit.corrected: Written into dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.why: Toxic Shot is on-hit magic damage scaling with attack speed, so the existing Mercury's Treads plus MR advice is already the right read — armour is not the answer and the page never claims it is.

edits.before: Teemo's blind (Q) is the whole problem — it cancels your Q autos and your basic attack, so don't step up to throw a Q he'll just blind. Last-hit with the tip of Q and eat a little poison; his poke can't actually burst a tank. Your one real threat is E: if he over-extends to poke near a wall, dash him into it for the stun, but if there's no wall you just shove him a few feet and he kites away on his move speed.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is the problem, but know its limit: it blinds basic attacks only, so Hammer Shock's zone and the Heroic Charge stun both land in full through it. Don't stand and auto through the blind — last-hit with the tip of Q and eat a little poison, because his poke can't burst a tank. Your one real threat is E: if he steps up to poke near a wall, dash him into it for the stun. With no wall you shove him a few feet and he kites off on Move Quick.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 stay even — your flat damage doesn't scale with points the way his poison does, so you're farming and tanking, not killing. W's armor/MR and move speed help you walk through his poke and close distance, but he resets the gap with passive haste and another blind. R at 6 is a disengage or a peel tool here, not a kill button — don't burn it trying to catch a Teemo who just runs.

notes: The page claimed four times that Blinding Dart cancels Hammer Shock as well as autos. It blinds basic attacks only — Q and the E wall stun land through it — and the already-audited mirror states the same from Teemo's side. Level chart was giving Teemo five of seven stages at 2/10 in a lane Poppy wins 51.21%; brought to the packet's shape. Note on a derived flag: champ-data/_kits/teemo.json tags Noxious Trap with 'knockup', which Riot's description does not support (it slows and damages over time), so the flagged knockup-enabler interaction was NOT written to the page.
